newsitem.title: USA: Newmont raises bid for Santa Fe Pacific to $2.2 billion.
newsitem.headline: Newmont raises bid for Santa Fe Pacific to $2.2 billion.

text.p: Newmont Mining Corp. said Tuesday it raised its unsolicited takeover bid for Santa Fe Pacific Gold to $16.50 per share, or $2.2 billion, in an attempt to derail the company's proposed merger with Homestake Mining Co.

Santa Fe agreed in early December to be acquired by Homestake in a stock deal then valued at $17.42 per share, or $2.3 billion. Based on Homestake's $13.50 stock price Tuesday, its bid of 1.115 of its shares for each Santa Fe share would be worth $15.0525 per share, or $2.0 billion.
The latest Newmont offer, of 0.40 of a Newmont share for each Santa Fe share, is significantly higher than Newmont's initial offer of 0.33 of a share.
